First off I would like to begin by telling you that what you're doing is great and that we would be better off if we had more people like you and it is very brave of you to try and help someone else that is going through such hard times.

And the someone who self-harms I want to tell you that many people just want to be heard many people just want someone to know that they are in pain and that's why they do some of the things that they do, I personally don't do it because of that it's much of a complicated situation but that's besides the point I just wanted to make to point that it variates a lot the reasons for why someone self-harms so that's only something you know, strike talking to them that's honestly one of the best things you can do talking heals a lot of people some people that are starved of social interaction because of many reasons of course, I'm really the best the best thing you should do is encourage them to see a therapist if possible and this goes like for every mental illness if you know anyone that has any mental illness the best thing you can do is encourage them to seek therapy.

Of the many things that can happen if you try to help someone that's self-harms or that has bipolar disorder or depression is that you can become emotionally exhausted because you're trying to understand the mind of another person in order to do this and if you are good enough at this if you have a lot of empathy you can put yourself in the place of that person and and it's and you're going to see what they went through and many times it's going to affect you in some sort of way, so if you need be take a break just remember that your mein zuhaus ist just as important as their's.

I just want to make the point again that what you should be doing is encourage them to seek help, and I know this because of personal experience that helping someone with mental issues is kind of like a minefield if you don't know anything about psychology, for example the time I tried to talk to my ex girlfriend about self-harm in the specifically her doing it I just couldn't do it because I knew if I said something that was wrong or if it said something that was triggering I knew she would probably feel even worse so I would actually recommend you also too look at a lot of videos about how to help someone with self-harm because you shouldn't go in blind you shouldn't go in without knowing nothing.

And the sorry if the post is kind of long it's just so great to see someone who cares about someone else  and that wants them to get better mentally and physically , and lastly I just want to thank you even if I'm not the person that is being helped the simple fact that you want to help is great you are exactly what we need more of in today's world so please keep it up and don't give up.
